content: Official release pages and npm metadata verify React 19.3.0, Node 24.22.2 LTS, Vite 8.3.5, Ant Design 6.6.6, React Router 8.5.1, TanStack React Query 5.105.3, Zustand 5.0.16, Zod 4.6.7, Vitest 5.1.0 and Playwright 1.64.1. React Router requires Node at least 22.22 and React at least 19.2.7, satisfied by proposed pair. These are candidates, not a locked or integration-tested baseline.
